w:r.w:t: Confidential — for ULP Engineering and Finance Teams
Initial release. India-only Accounts: GL, AR, AP, GST, IRN, TDS, Indian period close.

MAJOR refactor (50%): Split into M17-Core (universal GL/AR/AP/period-close primitives, multi-currency) + M17-IN-Plugin (GST, IRN, TDS, GSTR returns) + M17-US-Plugin (separate doc). Money type adopted; FX revaluation native. All v1.0 Indian functionality preserved as M17-IN-Plugin.

Every accounting feature documented in v1.0 remains fully present in v2.0. The refactor is structural — Indian GST, IRN, TDS, and statutory return capabilities are repackaged as M17-IN-Plugin but functionally identical to v1.0.
Chart of Accounts (Indian Ind AS aligned)

M17 (Accounts) provides accounting infrastructure for ULP tenants. It records financial transactions, manages GL/AR/AP, computes taxes, supports period close, and produces statutory and management reports. As of v2.0, the module is structured as Core + Plugins to support multiple tax regimes.
Universal: GL, journals, AR, AP, period close primitives, multi-currency, FX, audit trail, ageing, dunning
India: GST, IRN, e-Invoice, TDS, TCS, GSTR returns, NACH integration, Form 16A
United States: Sales tax (multi-state), 1099, W-9, ACH, US GAAP period close
Chart of Accounts (configurable per tenant; default trees per country)
Accounts Receivable: invoices, receipts, ageing, dunning
Accounts Payable: bills, payments, ageing, vendor management
Multi-currency support: Money type, FX rates, multi-currency journals
Period close primitives: open/close/reopen with approvals
Period lock enforcement: immutable closed periods
Audit trail: who/what/when/why on every change
Reconciliation engine (universal logic; country-specific bank formats via plugin)
Trial Balance, Income Statement, Balance Sheet (basic universal templates)
Country-specific return formats (GSTR vs sales tax)
